name: 青鸟收藏夹
description: 收藏链接并整理视频内容。在提供本地 Amadeus 存储的 Forsion Unit 或桌面宿主中,无需 Server、账号或网络即可收藏链接和阅读已有记录。视频分析使用宿主的 Tangu 引擎及包内 Agent / 技能;需要 Python / yt-dlp,无字幕时还需要 ffmpeg 与宿主音频转写。总结和问答使用已配置的模型,云端模型会接收任务所需内容。
descriptionEn: Save links and organize video content. On a Forsion Unit or Desktop host with local Amadeus storage, saving links and reading existing entries need no Server, account or network. Video analysis uses the host’s Tangu engine and the bundled agent and skills; it needs Python / yt-dlp, plus ffmpeg and host audio transcription for videos without captions. Summaries and questions use the configured model; cloud models receive the content required for their tasks.

onboarding.intro: 青鸟收藏夹是一个工作台视图,把视频链接变成可读可检索的笔记。配套的「青鸟收藏夹」Agent 与「青鸟视频分析」技能已内嵌在本捆绑包里,引擎启动时自动就位,无需另装。另带一个「青鸟链接收藏」技能:在**任意** Tangu 对话里丢一条文章/文档链接说「存一下」,就会抓正文、写成笔记存进库里的 Links/。默认会先确认一句;本页设置里打开「增强自动模式」后,单独发一条链接就直接存,不再问。

steps.title: 先收藏,随时阅读
steps.description: 打开工作台,贴链接后点「收藏链接」。使用宿主的本地笔记库时,此操作不需要网络、Tangu 引擎或 Forsion 账号;收藏会保存在正常的笔记与收藏列表中。

steps.title: 转录依赖
steps.description: 视频抓取需要提供本机执行能力的 Tangu 引擎和 Python / yt-dlp。无字幕的视频需要 ffmpeg 与宿主音频转写能力;后者可使用本地模型或已配置的供应商。缺少这些能力时,仍可收藏链接、阅读已有记录。

steps.title: 开用
steps.description: 命令面板「青鸟收藏夹:打开」开视图;贴链接(或整段分享文案)加入分析队列,可连贴多条排队跑,点队列行看直播进度;分析完自动存为 Markdown 笔记,落在插件的「工作文件夹」(默认「青鸟收藏夹」,首次打开即在库里建好,插件设置里可改),点「打开笔记」直达。

en.intro: Bluebird is a workbench view that turns video links into readable, searchable notes. The Bluebird agent and Bluebird Video Analysis skill are bundled and ready when the engine starts — nothing else to install. A second skill, Bluebird Link Capture, works in **any** Tangu chat: drop an article or doc link, say "save this", and it fetches the page into a note under Links/. It asks first by default; turn on Enhanced auto mode in this page's settings to save a link sent on its own without asking.

steps.title: Save now, read later
steps.description: Open the workbench, paste a link and choose Save link. With a local host vault, this needs no network, Tangu engine or Forsion account. The bookmark appears in your normal notes and library list.

steps.title: Transcription requirements
steps.description: Video fetching needs a Tangu engine with host execution and Python / yt-dlp. Videos without captions also need ffmpeg and host audio transcription, using a local model or configured provider. Saving links and reading existing entries remain available without these capabilities.

steps.title: Getting started
steps.description: Open the view from the command palette ("Bluebird: Open"), then paste a link — or a whole block of share text — to add it to the analysis queue. Queue several at once and click any row to watch it live. Finished analyses are saved as Markdown notes in the plugin work folder, which is created in your vault the first time you open the view and can be renamed in the plugin settings; "Open note" jumps straight to it.
